_doc: Body values both apps must agree on, beyond the packet types. Identical copies: protocol/testdata/desklink_v9/, DeskLink/testdata/ and desklink-mobile/src/test/resources/shared/; each side's test pins its own code to it (desk: shared_fixtures.rs, phone: protocol/WireValuesTest.kt).

settings._doc: desklink.settings (desk to phone): reportKeys are always present, the phone ignores a report missing one. desklink.settings.request {set} from the phone: only settable keys are applied (keepAwake also needs the desk's per-phone switch).

telephony._doc: callStates: desklink.telephony calls[].state. errors: desklink.telephony {error, action} ('failed' is the catch-all). emergency: numbers neither app dials (bare, '+' or '00' prefixed).
